notes: v1.1.109: Browser-less relogin, MetaMax-style. The request login now carries the account's OWN device cookies (datr/fr/sb/locale/wd...) before it logs in, so Facebook trusts the device and does not escalate to an Arkose puzzle - just password + 2FA and it's in, no browser. A dead cookie is revived the same way (seed_device = the stored cookie). When Facebook still does throw an Arkose wall the proven hidden browser is the fallback. Carries all of 1.1.108 (request-login 2FA/reCAPTCHA, compiled-build browser fallback), 1.1.107 (smart saved-login relogin, any-language login + English language switch) and 1.1.106.
